name: get_firewall_config
description:
Retrieve a project's firewall configuration for the given configVersion. Use `active` for the currently deployed configuration.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} firewall status --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
